# Security Policy

## Supported Version

Security support applies to the current version deployed from the `main` branch.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting to report security issues.

Do not publish sensitive vulnerability details in a public issue.

Include:

- A description of the vulnerability
- The affected page or file
- Steps to reproduce it
- Its possible security impact
- Screenshots or supporting evidence, when available

Reports will be reviewed as soon as reasonably possible.
